entities.name: Vickus
entities.description: A tall fourth-year Strixhaven student with vine-like hair, brutish and jealous, friend of Dina and Killian Lu.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A Strixhaven student with destructive ink magic and healing light magic who defeated Vickus in a duel.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A Strixhaven student and friend of Vickus and Killian Lu.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on the plane of Arcavios.

events.summary: Vickus, jealous over Killian's interaction with Dina, confronted Killian and challenged him to a duel.
events.quote: Vickus initially confronted Killian Lu , fueled by jealousy over Killian's interaction with Dina .

events.summary: Killian overpowered Vickus with ink magic, then chose to heal rather than destroy; Vickus was transformed by the light magic and later showed respect to Killian.
events.quote: When Killian chose to heal rather than destroy, Vickus was transformed by Killian's light magic

relations.note: He later expressed respect and camaraderie toward Killian.
relations.quote: Later, Vickus expressed respect and camaraderie toward Killian
